title: SDDE provider catalogue common structure
$comment: This schema owns only the closed common container. Each config object is subsequently validated against exactly one compiler-registered closed provider-specific variant. Runtime additionally enforces a capture of at most 1,048,576 bytes, strict UTF-8 without BOM, duplicate-key rejection, integer-only numeric tokens, nesting depth 16, model IDs of at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, at most 256 models total, unique provider definitions, and unique provider/model tuples.

json.description: Response-mode selector: true selects native JSON-schema output, which requires registered provider support; false selects prompt-only schema guidance.

config.$comment: Closed by the compiler-registered provider-specific schema during whole-catalogue construction.
